subject: business-studies
title: PESTLE Analysis
welcome_lead: Scan six external forces shaping every business decision.
meta_desc: A-Level External Environment: PESTLE analysis framework.
final_note: External change is constant - PESTLE keeps the radar tuned.

concepts.def: Growth, inflation, interest rates, exchange rates.

walkthroughs.body_html: PESTLE forces managers to look outside the firm. It surfaces threats and opportunities that internal SWOT can miss - Brexit, AI and net zero are all PESTLE drivers.
Brainstorm under each heading, then score each issue for likelihood and impact. Focus on the top 3 to 5 - a 60-bullet PESTLE that triggers no action is useless.
Letters interact: a technological change like remote work has social, economic and legal knock-ons. Treat PESTLE as a system, not a checklist.
